question: A person who is \(1.6\text{ m}\) tall casts a shadow \(2\text{ m}\) long. At the same time, a flagpole casts a shadow \(15\text{ m}\) long. How tall is the flagpole? (Unit: m)
solution: At the same time, object heights are proportional to their shadow lengths: \(1.6/2=h/15\), giving \(h=12\).
